frame: ICRS equatorial, +X vernal equinox, +Z north celestial pole, origin at the solar-system barycentre
units: positions in parsecs; absmag is absolute visual magnitude

_source.stars: HYG / AT-HYG (hyglike_from_athyg_v40), David Nash, astronexus.com, CC BY-SA 4.0. Hipparcos + Yale Bright Star + Gliese, distances updated from Gaia DR3/DR2.
_source.lines: Sky & Telescope constellation figures via Stellarium's western_SnT sky culture (Paul Krizak, Jonathan E. Piskor; rework by the Stellarium team), CC BY-SA 2.0. There is no official standard for constellation stick figures.
_source.color: B-V converted to temperature by Ballesteros (2012), then to sRGB along the black-body locus, normalised to hue only.
